In this plan, 4% वाला जो number होता है वो सिर्फ ‘standard illustration’ का low-return example है — यह कोई guaranteed bonus नहीं है.
ACE Plan में guaranteed part सिर्फ income/benefit structure का होता है. Actual bonus या return company की future performance पर depend करता है.

इसलिए illustration में जो 4% और 8% दिया जाता है, वो सिर्फ estimate है — guarantee नहीं

और अगर आप plan में पूरी guarantee ढूंढ रहे हैं, तो इस तरह के participating plans की जगह आपको non-par, non-linked guaranteed plan consider करना चाहिए — जहाँ benefits fixed होते हैं और bonus पर depend नहीं करते

Plan Name:- Bajaj ACE Goal Protected

Entry Age:- 18-55 Years

Type:- A Non Linked, Participate, individual life insurance saving Plan

Features:-
1. Decide your income amount & income start year
2. Policy term 10-45 years or at age of 85 years
3. Primume paying :- 12 years
4. Continuity of policy benefit after death with goal protected benefits
5. Life cover to secure your planned life goals.
6. Tax benefit

Advantages:-
1. Primume amount will invest in some percentage in early income benefit & some in wealth creation.

2. Income benefit is sum of cash bonus, revisory bonus, survival benefits.

3. You have lock your interest rate for next 45 years.

4. You will get both income benefit & maturity benefits along with life cover amount if policy holder is no more
